title: Noncombustible membrane.
officialText: A noncombustible membrane shall be permitted for use as the roof or as a skylight of any building or atrium of a building of any type of construction, provided it is at least 20 feet (6096mm) above any floor, balcony or gallery, and meets the fire classification requirements of Section 1505 for roof assemblies.
